title: Which of These Best Describes Multiple Choice Evaluation with LLMs? A) Forced B) Flawed C) Fixable D) All of the Above

bias_targets.methodology: Testing LLMs with shuffled option positions, different choice symbols (e.g., A/B/C vs. P/Q/R), and specific phrases (e.g., 'none of the above') to demonstrate how models inconsistently select answers based on formatting rather than content.
Synthesizing prior literature to highlight performance disparities where LLMs frequently err on non-Western cultural multiple-choice questions and subjective commonsense tasks.

Synthesizing prior literature to demonstrate performance disparities and evaluation challenges on non-English multiple-choice questions, particularly regarding translation error propagation and low-resource languages.
